title: moleculeace-serialization-audit: code and data for "SMILES serialization changes activity-cliff annotations in the MoleculeACE benchmark"
description:
Code, serialization-invariant activity-cliff label sets, split assignments (including 24 same-definition split realizations), analysis result tables, figure source data and per-molecule test predictions of every fitted model for the study SMILES serialization changes activity-cliff annotations in the MoleculeACE benchmark.

The study holds the molecules, potencies, thresholds and code of the MoleculeACE benchmark (molML/MoleculeACE, commit 7e6de0bd2968c56589c580f2a397f01c531ede26) fixed and varies only the SMILES serialization of the same molecules. Re-serialization with Indigo and Open Babel changed a median of 8.98% and 9.48% of compound labels; the graph-derived criteria were invariant. The release allows MoleculeACE to be re-evaluated under any of four cliff definitions without retraining.
